en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a residential city street with a railway bridge crossing above a sunken cobblestone road. In the foreground is the underpass, with a lone pedestrian walking below the bridge. Rail tracks run across the image on top of the bridge, with telegraph poles and wires alongside. On the left stands a large early‑20th‑century townhouse or apartment building with steep, tiled roof and dormer windows; commercial signs are mounted on or near the building. A tree‑lined avenue extends straight into the distance on the right side, bordered by more residential buildings and dense trees.
